decisions: The project owner explicitly waived the ten-real-participant requirement for this phase on 07/10/2026.
The waiver is represented as REJECTED_WITH_REASON, never as DONE.
Synthetic personas and automated pilots must never be reported as human usability results.
Use DEMO only and keep any future participant data anonymized.
risks: Human discoverability and comprehension remain empirically unmeasured.
A future production-facing phase may choose to reinstate the real-participant requirement.
